这项研究聚焦“IBDex: A Frozen Patient-Scale Atlas for Bulk Transcriptomics in Inflammatory Bowel Disease”，核心对象来自 medrxiv。

局限 / Limitations

本卡基于题录与摘要自动生成，尚未核对全文中的样本量、效应值、亚组分析、偏倚控制及作者原始局限。

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Background and Aims: Bulk mucosal RNA sequencing in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is analyzed one cohort at a time, so each study rebuilds its own molecular scale.

We aimed to build a frozen atlas that new cohorts could use without retraining.

Methods: We built IBDex from 3,168 intestinal biopsies from 1,680 patients with Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis or no IBD, drawn from four cohorts.

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Clinical interventions for cancer treatment toxicities can reduce morbidity, mortality, and healthcare cost, if high risk patients can be identified.

We developed SPARC, a transformer-based foundation model, using real-world, longitudinal, routinely collected health measurements, to predict adverse event risk.

Pre-training and fine-tuning SPARC on 101,920,379 measurements from 224,047 patients with cancer led to state-of-the-art performance at predicting cancer-related adverse events on (i) held-out data from the development cohort, (ii) a prospective validation cohort from the same center (Npatients=23,126), (iii) multiple publicly available external datasets (Npatients=26,012), and (iv) external, multi-hospital cohorts (Npatients=562,620, 206,840).

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Tumours comprise heterogeneous phenotypic states, but how these states are reorganized during malignant progression and therapeutic adaptation remains poorly understood.

Here we integrate spatial transcriptomic, single-cell, spatial proteomic, bulk-transcriptomic and perturbational data to examine breast cancer progression as a tissue-embedded phenotype cloud.

A graph-neural-network-derived progression coordinate combined with Field--Flow--Front analysis revealed reproducible transitions between distinct organizational regimes.

Summary Background No known treatments prevent Parkinson's disease (PD) onset or delay its progression.

Prior observational studies of antihypertensive medications and PD risk have produced inconsistent findings and may be susceptible to confounding and reverse causation.

Methods We applied a multi-stage analytical framework integrating medication-wide screening, independent cohort replication, target trial emulation, and exploratory transcriptomic analyses.

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Background: The landmark genome-wide association meta-analysis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and AD-by-proxy across N = 2,815,127 individuals (Uffelmann et al., Nature, 2026) expanded the known susceptibility landscape to 127 independent genomic risk loci (160 association signals) and established an autosomal common-variant SNP heritability of h2_SNP = 16.0% on the liability scale.

Translating these 127 static statistical signals into pathway-stratified clinical trials requires resolving three quantitative gaps: how the non-APOE polygenic architecture partitions across distinct cellular programs, which effector genes operate via cortical parenchymal versus peripheral myeloid gene expression, and which targets possess nanomolar human bioactivity suitable for genetically stratified trials.

Methods: Operating entirely on individual-genotype-free summary statistics structured along a previously established tridimensional diagnostic framework (Axis 1: Etiology and Genetic Architecture; Axis 2: Molecular Pathophysiology and Biomarker Programs; Axis 3: Neuroanatomical-Cognitive Topography; Menendez-Gonzalez, Alzheimers Dement, 2025), we ingested the complete NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog build GCST90695466 (8,159,496 autosomal and 160,704 X-chromosome variants).

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Clinical interventions for cancer treatment toxicities can reduce morbidity, mortality, and healthcare cost, if high risk patients can be identified.

We developed SPARC, a transformer-based foundation model, using real-world, longitudinal, routinely collected health measurements, to predict adverse event risk.

Pre-training and fine-tuning SPARC on 101,920,379 measurements from 224,047 patients with cancer led to state-of-the-art performance at predicting cancer-related adverse events on (i) held-out data from the development cohort, (ii) a prospective validation cohort from the same center (Npatients=23,126), (iii) multiple publicly available external datasets (Npatients=26,012), and (iv) external, multi-hospital cohorts (Npatients=562,620, 206,840).

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Tumours comprise heterogeneous phenotypic states, but how these states are reorganized during malignant progression and therapeutic adaptation remains poorly understood.

Here we integrate spatial transcriptomic, single-cell, spatial proteomic, bulk-transcriptomic and perturbational data to examine breast cancer progression as a tissue-embedded phenotype cloud.

A graph-neural-network-derived progression coordinate combined with Field--Flow--Front analysis revealed reproducible transitions between distinct organizational regimes.

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Background: The landmark genome-wide association meta-analysis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and AD-by-proxy across N = 2,815,127 individuals (Uffelmann et al., Nature, 2026) expanded the known susceptibility landscape to 127 independent genomic risk loci (160 association signals) and established an autosomal common-variant SNP heritability of h2_SNP = 16.0% on the liability scale.

Translating these 127 static statistical signals into pathway-stratified clinical trials requires resolving three quantitative gaps: how the non-APOE polygenic architecture partitions across distinct cellular programs, which effector genes operate via cortical parenchymal versus peripheral myeloid gene expression, and which targets possess nanomolar human bioactivity suitable for genetically stratified trials.

Methods: Operating entirely on individual-genotype-free summary statistics structured along a previously established tridimensional diagnostic framework (Axis 1: Etiology and Genetic Architecture; Axis 2: Molecular Pathophysiology and Biomarker Programs; Axis 3: Neuroanatomical-Cognitive Topography; Menendez-Gonzalez, Alzheimers Dement, 2025), we ingested the complete NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog build GCST90695466 (8,159,496 autosomal and 160,704 X-chromosome variants).

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Background: Klebsiella pneumoniae (Kp) is a leading cause of hospital and community acquired pneumonia and bacteraemia, and hypervirulent and carbapenem resistant lineages continue to expand worldwide.

Although individual omics layers of Kp infection have been profiled, the host-level molecular logic that connects transcriptional, cellular, metabolic and spatial programmes has not been systematically integrated.

Methods: We curated 16 public datasets spanning four modalities-bulk and dual host pathogen RNA-seq (six datasets; 118 libraries), single-cell RNA-seq (four datasets; {approx}164,000 cells), untargeted/targeted metabolomics (four datasets; 1,842 molecular features) and Visium spatial transcriptomics (two datasets; {approx}11,400 spots) covering murine lung infection models, hypervirulent and classical Kp strains, carbapenem-resistant isolates and human clinical specimens.
